messages:
maya: starting canary v2.7.0 -> 5% (change window 04:00-04:30 UTC). tagging @oliver @sam for post-deploy smoke.
deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: rollout started · target=5% · checks=health, synth-wave, kv-prefill
oliver: launching synth-wave (short/long/tokenize) and prefills. will post failures.
sam: watching queue depth and backpressure metrics.
deploy-bot: synth-wave update · short:ok long:ok tokenize:ok · kv-prefill:ok
maya: holding at 5% for 10m. if synth-wave or backpressure rises, we rollback.
deploy-bot: telemetry heartbeat scheduled in 60s
oliver: note: small bump in `/generate/stream` p99 on canary-1 from 900ms -> 1.6s, no errors. investigating.
sam: seeing transient connection queue growth on canary-1 node, correlates with increased batch sizes from new tokenizer shard.
maya: cordon canary-1 from new requests, keep weight at 5%. cordon applied.
deploy-bot: cordon applied to pod canary-1 · traffic redistributed
oliver: reran synth-wave against healthy canaries: pass. queued requests drained on canary-1 after cordon.
maya: rework plan: proceed to 20% excluding canary-1. monitor for 15m. rollback if p99 > 1.2s or synth failures repeat.
sam: rollback cmd ready: `deployctl rollback --to v2.6.4 --selector canary=true`
maya: thanks team, holding window until 04:30 UTC.
